primitives.verbatim_quote: # Agent Tool Permission Matrix Updated: 2026-07-03 Hard default: no agent can deploy, spend, publish, scrape restricted sources, store secrets in memory, or claim model edge without measured evidence.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A': 'Agent set, dimensionless', 'T': 'Tool set, dimensionless', 'E': 'Evidence space, dimensionless', 'M': 'Memory state, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Each agent A has a subset T ⊆ T_total; permissions are binary functions over (A, T); memory M is constrained by evidence E.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When |E| → 0, permission lattice collapses to trivial Boolean algebra.

primitives.name: Secure Memory Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: store secrets in memory, or claim model edge without measured evidence. | Agent | Allowed tools
primitives.assumptions: Memory state M is a function of secrets S and evidence E; S ⊆ M iff E > threshold.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When E < threshold, S ∩ M = ∅; when E ≥ threshold, S ⊆ M.

layer2.mapping: Memory constraint defines kernel of secure computation; secrets are embedded only when empirical evidence supports their retention.
layer2.telemetry: Observable: secret storage flag; Verification: cryptographic integrity check against evidence ledger.
